title: Three Summers and One Short Basin
subtitle: 园林景观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 园林景观（人与自然·自然生态·园林与景观）
meta: 主题语境：园林景观（人与自然·自然生态·园林与景观）　|　核心词汇：fountain　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fountain 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the gardener ① built a fountain that no visitor in the square would have described, and he said the building was the whole of the summer. The ② fountain, meaning the jet itself and not the pool, ran three summers and stayed undescribed in the book; a fountain, he said, is the only thing in a square that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ fountain in that square had the same short basin beside it, and the ④ fountain at the far end, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A fountain, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the gardener said the describing is the part that fills three summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the fountain was the whole of the matter, meaning the source and not the jet. The ⑥ fountain, meaning the source and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; fountain, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both a jet and a source. He said the source is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ fountain had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short basin. The ⑧ fountain of the whole thing, the gardener wrote in July, was one square and three summers of describing; fountain, he said, is either the one at the far end or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ fountain I remember is the one described in the plan, which closed in 1973 and is still described as the quietest in the square. A ⑩ fountain, my mother said in 1975, is the only one that improves by being described; every fountain, she said, is a source that has agreed to look like a jet. She said the source was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 喷泉（指广场上每一座旁边的那一座）
B. n. 喷泉（指那水柱本身，与水池相对）
C. 固定搭配：build a fountain 建一座喷泉
D. n. 喷泉（指留给孩子们的那一座）
E. n. 喷泉（抽象总称，指一处广场的喷泉之事）
F. n. 喷泉（指计划里写到、被描述过的那一座）
G. n. 源泉；来源（a fountain of，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）
H. n. 源泉（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）

items.q: built a fountain that no visitor in the square would have described
The fountain, meaning the jet itself and not the pool
the fountain at the far end
the fountain was the whole of the matter
the fountain had become a line in a plan
The fountain of the whole thing
A fountain, my mother said in 1975

answers.why: build a fountain 意为“建一座喷泉”，1964 年那位园丁建了一座广场上没有一位游客肯描述的喷泉。
fountain 意为“喷泉”，指那水柱本身而不是水池，它经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被描述。
fountain 意为“喷泉”，指广场上每一座旁边的那一座，每一座旁边都有同一个矮矮的水盆。
fountain 意为“喷泉”，指留给孩子们的那一座，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
fountain 意为“源泉、来源”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西，叔叔说这处源泉就是那件事的全部。
fountain 意为“源泉”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西而不是那座喷泉，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
fountain 意为“喷泉”，指计划里写到、被描述过的那一座，到 1971 年这一座成了计划里的一行。
fountain 意为“喷泉”，园丁七月写道，整件事的喷泉之事是一处广场和三个夏天的描述。
fountain 意为“喷泉”，我记得的是计划里描述过的那一座，1973 年结束了，至今仍被说成广场上最安静的一座。
fountain 为抽象总称，母亲 1975 年说，一座喷泉是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的东西。
